forcedTwoSampleCeiling.fallbackReason: RGBA16F does not support 4x MSAA; using 2x.

forcedNoSamples.fallbackReason: RGBA16F does not support multisampling; using SMAA Ultra.

invalidAaControl.exitSemantics: runner allowlist rejects before capture; URL startup throws
expectedErrors: Error: Unsupported aa mode "not-a-mode". Expected one of: ultra, high, medium, low, fxaa, msaa2, msaa4, msaa2-smaa, off.

decision.shippingPolicy: SMAA Ultra with auto DPR capped at 1.5 and about 3.34M drawing-buffer pixels
decision.reason: No tested MSAA mode improves Retina temporal stability by 10% while also passing the 16.7ms worst-p95 gate.
decision.taaReason: No motion-vector buffer or object-motion/disocclusion history-rejection contract exists.
